# prototype-userguide

> An unofficial, practical user guide for scientists using NSF Ocean Observatories Initiative
> (OOI) data: what the data products are, how to get them, what is in a delivered file, how to read
> the quality-control flags, and what to distrust. Each page cites its primary sources; official
> sources take precedence. Status: v0 skeleton — pages below are planned and not yet written.

## Guides

- [Shallow profiler operations](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/shallow-profiler.md): READ FIRST for any shallow-profiler question. The platform and its three sites (designators, coordinates); a profile's ascent/descent/rest phases and durations; the daily index (1-9, UTC day) and which sensors run on which profiles (nitrate, pH, pCO2 only on #4 and #9); the profile index and GPI (global profile index): what it is, where to get it, code to cut a delivered stream into profiles; the "redux" one-file-per-profile-per-sensor convention and its filename; UTC time.
- [Data access](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/data-access.md): The routes to OOI data (Data Explorer, OOINET, ERDDAP, THREDDS, cloud object storage, Zenodo) and which to use for what. (planned)
- [Quality-control flags](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/qc-flags.md): How to read QARTOD and automated QC flag variables in delivered files, and which values mean "do not use". (planned)
- [Currents](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/currents.md): Where ocean current (velocity) data live — product codes, instruments (ADCP, point current meters), sites — and known processing resources. (planned)
- [Profiling CTD with dissolved oxygen (CTDPF)](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/ctd.md): Which variables to use for temperature, salinity, pressure/depth, conductivity, density, and oxygen; density is IN-SITU (compute potential density with GSW for stratification/mixed-layer work); oxygen units and the duplicate oxygen variable; QARTOD and OOI QC flags in CTD files (conductivity-suspect vs salinity-pass; misleading stuck-value failures); conductivity-cell fouling events; shallow-profiler stream specifics.
- [Nitrate (NUTNR, SUNA)](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/nitrate.md): Which nitrate variable to use (salinity_corrected_nitrate, L2, not the uncorrected L1); units are per liter (convert before combining with per-kg oxygen); measured only on shallow-profiler profiles #4 and #9, ascent only, ~170 samples (~1-2 m spacing); QC flags (global-range failures = negative values); near-zero negatives, drift and the need for bottle checks, CTD-dependence of the correction; instrument clock fields that run months behind (use time).
- [3-wavelength fluorometer (FLORT)](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/flort.md): Which variable to use for chlorophyll, CDOM, and backscatter (L1 vs L2, particulate b_bp); what all 48 variables in a delivered file are; how to read QARTOD and OOI QC bit-mask flags (and why stuck-value "failures" mislead); what to distrust: low-signal quantization, the ~2x chlorophyll calibration bias, daytime quenching, CDOM vs FDOM, biofouling, empty calibration fields; shallow-profiler stream specifics.

## Reference

- [Program website index](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/ref-program-site.md): Annotated links into the observatory program website: data product pages, instrument pages, data product specifications, knowledge base. (planned)
- [Interactive Oceans index](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/ref-interactive-oceans.md): Annotated links into the Regional Cabled Array site: instrument pages and the Data Portal. (planned)

## Datasets

- [Zenodo nsf-ooi catalog](https://robfatland.github.io/prototype-userguide/datasets.md): Community-published OOI-derived datasets and software on Zenodo, with size, whether code and documentation are included, and DOIs. Generated from the Zenodo API. (planned)
